title: 第二章 无人生还第三章 头汤
content_zh:
那个声厉内荏的中年人迈着急匆匆的脚步，如逃一般离开这个房间。
周游本来还想拦住再详细问问的，可惜系统提示他要这么干直接判定游戏失败——于是只能摇摇头，先简单地搜索了下周围。
一眼看去，这就是个普普通通的保安室，地方不大，略显寒碜，房间里七零八落地摆放着一些安保设施，门口还挂着一些市政部门的所在地，以及他这个岗位的巡逻地图和巡逻须知，
不过和通常只需要负责一个小区的保安不同，这里需要巡逻的范围是整个街区，而屋子里也没有工作用的电脑之类的东西，只有一台颇为为老旧的电视——周游试了试，发现早就坏了许久，根本无法打开。
桌子上倒是堆着几张报纸，可惜的是大概由于游戏的限制，其中大部分的文字都如同被水浸透般弥散开来，十分难以阅读，仅能从某些地方稍微拼凑出几个词语。
“事故....频发.....”
“首富.....重病.....抢救中.....”
“诚招.....急缺......待遇优厚......”
“一摊贩....过劳死.....自己的家人....”
“贪污....调查记者....将要.....”
“收购......屠宰场........”
周游仔细看了许久，却也未能找到什么有用的线索。
毕竟其中大多词语都变得破碎不堪，根本无法猜测其中含义，只能从从诚招和急缺两个字来猜测这条招聘新闻或许和自己现在这个任务有关——但问题是待遇优厚？
他可没忘记开场介绍里就说了，这份工作仅是能让他‘饿不死’而已。
发现这里无法得到东西后，周游又转头望向另一边。
那里正摆着一本签到薄。
纸张四寸见方，并不算老旧，不过大概是由于平时使用时不怎么......珍惜，上面已经布满了各种泥印和油污，第一页是白班的巡逻人员和执勤表，看起来没任何问题，但在翻到第二页夜班执勤表的时候，他的脸色却稍微沉了一下。
上面依旧是各种名字，但和第一页几乎完全固定的人员不同，这一页的巡逻人员每隔一天就换个名字，并且所有姓名都没重复过。
当然，最主要的还是....
所有人，都没完成过执勤。

签到表上，只有到岗那一栏位打了排对号，而离岗的那一栏则是完完全全的一片空白。
——所以说，那些员工究竟遭遇了什么事情，为什么连回都回不来？
想到这里，再看那件疑似染上血污的保安服时，只会让人感觉到一阵又一阵的毛骨悚然。
在他沉思的时候，突然间有一个清脆的报时声响起，周游抬起头看向时钟，才发现在这么一会的功夫里，时针已经不知不觉的指向了11点。
到夜间巡逻的时间了。
虽然游戏并未规定任何迟到的惩罚，但他也不想特地去试一试后果，所以周游仅是紧了紧外套，再度环顾了一圈保安室，确定没什么遗漏后，才拿起手电筒，就这么走了出去。
------------------
保安室外。
夜晚的街道死寂无声。
周游刚才在巡逻须知中了解到，这片街区本来是打算改建为新城区的，所以大半数的住户都已迁走，只剩下一些比较顽固的还在坚持不肯搬家。
看似很合理的解答。
但问题是.....
他忽然抬起头，环顾周围。
那些老旧的楼房中没有任何灯光亮起，也见不到任何人类活动的痕迹，在紧锁的大门中偶然间能听到一些希希索索的声音，但只要仔细一辩认，那些声音就会立刻沉寂下来，仿佛刚才所听到的一切都只是某种幻觉。
content_en:
The stern and angry middle-aged man left the room with hurried steps as if fleeing.
Zhou You originally wanted to stop him and ask in detail, but unfortunately the system prompted him to do so and directly determine the game to be failed - so he could only shake his head and briefly search around.
At first glance, this is an ordinary security room. The place is small and slightly shabby. There are some security facilities scattered around the room. There are also the locations of some municipal departments hanging on the door, as well as the patrol map and patrol instructions for his position.
However, unlike the security guards who usually only have to be responsible for one community, the area that needs to be patrolled here is the entire block, and there is no work computer or anything like that in the house. There is only a rather old TV - Zhou You tried it and found that it had been broken for a long time and could not be turned on at all.
There are a few newspapers stacked on the table. Unfortunately, probably due to the limitations of the game, most of the text is spread out as if soaked in water, making it very difficult to read. Only a few words can be pieced together from some places.
"Accidents...happen frequently..."
"The richest man... is seriously ill... and is being rescued..."
"Recruiting...urgent need...good pay..."
"A street vendor...died from overwork...his own family..."
"Corruption...investigative reporters...will..."
"Acquisition...slaughterhouse..."
Zhou You looked carefully for a long time, but could not find any useful clues.
After all, most of the words in it have become broken and broken, and it is impossible to guess their meaning. I can only guess from the words "sincere recruitment" and "urgent shortage" that this recruitment news may be related to my current task - but the question is: good salary?
He didn't forget to say in the opening introduction that this job would only keep him from starving to death.
After realizing that he couldn't get anything here, Zhou You turned his head and looked to the other side.
There is a sign-in book sitting there.
The paper was four inches square and was not old, but it was covered with various mud marks and oil stains, probably due to not being... cherished during normal use. The first page was the patrol personnel and duty list of the day shift, which seemed fine, but when he turned to the second page of the night shift duty list, his face darkened a little.
There are still various names on it, but unlike the almost completely fixed personnel on the first page, the patrol officers on this page change their names every other day, and none of the names are repeated.
Of course, the most important thing is...
Everyone has never completed their duty.
On the sign-in form, only the column for arriving at work was marked, while the column for leaving work was completely blank.
——So, what happened to those employees, and why can’t they even come back?
Thinking of this, when looking at the security uniform that was suspected to be stained with blood, it would only make people feel creepy.
While he was meditating, a clear sound of time suddenly sounded. Zhou You raised his head and looked at the clock, only to find that in such a short time, the hour hand had unconsciously pointed to 11 o'clock.
It's time for night patrol.
Although the game did not stipulate any penalty for being late, he didn't want to go out of his way to try the consequences, so Zhou You just tightened his coat and looked around the security room again. After making sure that nothing was missing, he picked up the flashlight and walked out.
------------------
Outside the security room.
The streets at night were dead silent.
Zhou You just learned from the patrol instructions that this block was originally planned to be converted into a new urban area, so most of the residents have moved out, leaving only some stubborn ones who still insist on moving.
Seems like a very reasonable answer.But the problem is...
He suddenly raised his head and looked around.
There are no lights on in those old buildings, and there are no traces of human activity. Occasionally, some humming sounds can be heard in the locked doors, but as long as you identify them carefully, those sounds will immediately become silent, as if everything you just heard is just some kind of hallucination.
